ig_single.caption:
Two Bitwise execs (including the CIO), BitGo, Gemini and Ivan on Tech all publicly engaged Kaspa in the same week.

For two years the objection was "nobody knows what it is." No premine, so no war chest to buy shelf space, so no big listing, so no attention. That was the loop.
